Listen to this article Share As part of activities marking 60 years of existence in Nigeria, MAGGI, a brand of Nestlé Nigeria has launched its MAGGI @ 60 Text and Win promotion. The promotion is said to offer consumers the opportunity to win 12 brand-new SUVs, 60 cash prizes of ₦1 million each, and thousands of other rewards, including household appliances, airtime and additional cash prizes. Report has shown that over six decades, MAGGI has evolved alongside the changing tastes, preferences and needs of Nigerian consumers, continually innovating its products while Nestlé has invested in the local manufacturing capabilities and partnerships that support the brand’s growth. Speaking at the anniversary press conference in Lagos, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Nestlé Nigeria Plc, Wassim Elhusseini, described the milestone as a celebration of the trust Nigerians have placed in the brand over the years. “When we look back on 60 years of MAGGI in Nigeria, we see far more than the history of a brand. We see generations of families who have made us part of their lives, investments that have helped strengthen local capabilities, and partnerships that have created opportunities for people and businesses across the country. “These contributions remind us of the responsibility that comes with the trust Nigerians have placed in us. That means maintaining the quality and standards consumers expect from us, while continuing to listen to their needs. As we celebrate this milestone, our commitment is to keep earning that trust and contributing positively to Nigeria’s future,” he said. Nestlé’s investment in local manufacturing has also supported the development of MAGGI’s value chain, bringing together farmers, suppliers, transporters, distributors and retailers who contribute to the brand’s production and distribution across Nigeria. To mark the anniversary, MAGGI is recognising and rewarding the consumers and business partners who have contributed to its journey. On her part, Category Business Manager for Culinary at Nestlé Nigeria, Funmi Osineye,who also spoke on the anniversary celebrations affirmed that the brand had planned a series of exciting activities to reward consumers and recognise the partners who have contributed to its success. “We wanted to celebrate 60 years of MAGGI in a truly MAGGI-NIFICENT way, with the people who have made this journey possible at the heart of it all. “Through our MAGGI @ 60 Text and Win promotion, we are giving 12 lucky Nigerians the opportunity to drive home brand-new SUVs and making 60 other millionaires, with ₦1 million each. “There are also thousands of other exciting prizes to be won, including lots of deep freezers, triple-door refrigerators, cookers, ovens, microwaves, fans, airtime and several cash prizes to be won. It is our way of saying thank you to Nigerians for six wonderful decades and inviting everyone to celebrate with us,” she said.
